description: This file defines a Snapshotter class used for capturing and managing page frame snapshots within a browser context, including methods for starting, resetting, capturing snapshots, and handling frame hierarchy annotations.

classes.name: Snapshotter
classes.description: Manages page snapshot capturing, including starting, resetting, capturing frame snapshots, and handling frame hierarchy annotations within a browser context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the snapshotter, initializes scripts if needed, and resets state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the snapshotter state in all frames.

methods.name: resetForReuse
methods.description: Prepares the snapshotter for reuse by removing init scripts and event listeners.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Initializes the snapshotter by setting up event listeners and injecting scripts into pages.

methods.name: _captureFrameSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of a specific frame.

methods.name: captureSnapshot
methods.description: Captures snapshots for all frames in a page and delegates the snapshot data.

methods.name: _onPage
methods.description: Handles new page events to set up frame hierarchy annotation.

methods.name: _annotateFrameHierarchy
methods.description: Annotates frame hierarchy for snapshot purposes.
